hits.title: Superblocks and AWS Announce Strategic Collaboration to Bring Secure Enterprise AI App Development to Amazon Bedrock - US Press Center
hits.snippet: NEW YORK – Jul 28, 2026 – Superblocks, the enterprise vibe-coding platform for generating internal AI applications, and Amazon Web Services (AWS), an Amazon.com, Inc. company (NASDAQ: AMZN), today announced a multi-year collaboration to make Superblocks' generative AI platform available within customers' AWS environments, including Amazon Bedrock. Amazon Bedrock is a platform for building generative AI applications and agents at production scale, providing access to a broad selection of fully managed models from leading AI companies through a unified API.
